findings.title: Delete action never appears in the new ruler-less list view
findings.body: canDelete is now computed as ruler-ability OR grafana-prom-ability (line 87), but the Delete menu item is still guarded by `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the new list view (GrafanaRuleListItem/FilterView/GrafanaGroupLoader) only promRule is passed and rulerRule is undefined, so Delete is never rendered even for users with delete permission, despite the new prom-based ability logic and the handleDelete plumbing. The delete capability added for prom rules is effectively dead in the view it was added for.

findings.title: Pause action never appears in the new ruler-less list view
findings.body: canPause is computed as ruler-ability OR grafana-prom-ability (line 83), but rendering requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and renders MenuItemPauseRule with the rulerRule. In the new list view rulerRule is undefined, so Pause/Unpause is never shown for Grafana rules even when the prom-based ability grants it. Pausing from the list view is lost by this PR.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing in the new list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can now show Silence based solely on the prom-rule ability, and clicking it calls handleSilence which sets showSilenceDrawer=true here. However the drawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, and `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined in the ruler-less list view (GrafanaRuleListItem passes only promRule). Users see and click 'Silence notifications' and nothing happens.

findings.title: Grafana rule list items rendered without React key
findings.body: The grafana case in the rules.map() switch returns <GrafanaRuleListItem> without the `key={key}` prop that the previous GrafanaRuleLoader element and the sibling datasource case have. In a paginated/infinite-scroll list that concatenates batches, React will reconcile these items by index, causing incorrect component/state reuse when the list grows or changes and key-duplication warnings. Restore key={key} (or key on promRule.uid).

findings.title: Federated rule groups are now treated as editable/removable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously computed isFederated via isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) and marked such rules immutable (Update/Delete/Pause unsupported). The refactored useAllRulerRuleAbilities used by it hardcodes `const isFederated = false` with a TODO. CombinedRule consumers (existing rule list/details) for datasource-managed federated groups will now offer Edit/Delete/Pause to permitted users for rules that must be immutable, leading to failing or invalid ruler writes.
